settings.title: 800 Parker Pens for a Corporate Event
settings.request: A client needed 800 Parker pens for a corporate event.
settings.our_work: Our production team prepared the order in a couple of days. With the client located nearby, we delivered it directly to their door.
settings.result: The client later returned with another large order.
settings.image_alt: Personalized black pens arranged in individual gift boxes, part of an 800-pen bulk order by Elma Vada Studio.

settings.title: 74 Engraved Pens for an Iftar Gathering
settings.request: A client needed 74 Parker Frontier pens with Cyrillic engraving for an upcoming iftar gathering, with very little time to spare.
settings.our_work: We finalized the engraving details and completed production in one day.
settings.result: The pens were delivered before the client’s deadline. In their feedback, the client praised Daria for going above and beyond.
settings.image_alt: Personalized black pens arranged in individual gift boxes, part of an 800-pen bulk order by Elma Vada Studio.

settings.title: 75 Walnut Chopstick Sets for a Hotel Dinner
settings.request: A hospitality client ordered 75 walnut chopstick sets with presentation boxes and a logo for a corporate dinner.
settings.our_work: We personalized the sets with the client’s logo, ensuring the design fit the available engraving area.
settings.result: The client left a five-star review praising the quality and presentation.
settings.image_alt: Bulk walnut chopstick sets with presentation boxes and a logo for a corporate dinner. Elmavada studio

settings.title: 60 Branded Gift Sets for a Law Firm
settings.request: A law firm ordered 60 walnut chopstick sets with boxes and a logo for a corporate event.
settings.our_work: We prepared the branded sets to the agreed design for the event.
settings.result: The client returned with an order for 20 Parker pen sets, continuing the relationship with a different gift selection.

settings.title: 130 Bookmarks Shipped the Next Day
settings.request: A client ordered 130 bookmarks with a religious theme.
settings.our_work: When a checkout issue prevented the full quantity from being placed in one order, we coordinated two separate orders and shipped them together. The order was placed on August 12 and dispatched on August 13, 2025.
settings.result: The client praised our professionalism and was delighted with the order.
settings.image_alt: Engraved metal bookmark with cross charm by Elma Vada Studio. DWF

settings.title: 2,000 Logo-Engraved Glasses for an Oil & Gas Company
settings.request: An oil and gas company needed 2,000 mojito glasses engraved with its logo.
settings.our_work: We found a supplier who could ship and deliver the full quantity within one week. Engraving took another week, with two engravers working full shifts on the project while two other engravers continued handling other orders. The completed order was carefully checked before delivery.
settings.result: The order was delivered, and the client was pleased with the quality.

settings.title: 50 Parker Pen Sets for a Returning Client
settings.request: A returning client from a surgical institute needed another batch of 50 Parker pen sets.
settings.our_work: We discussed alternative pens and boxes, worked through several options, and agreed on the combination the client preferred.
settings.result: The order was placed on March 1 and dispatched on March 2, 2026. The client praised the quality of the materials and our communication.

settings.question: What information should I send for a quote?
settings.answer: Share the occasion, estimated quantity, target date, delivery location and any artwork you already have. A budget range helps narrow the options.

settings.question: Can every gift have a different name?
settings.answer: Include personalization requirements in your request. We will confirm the suitable product, method and recipient-list format for the project.

settings.question: Can I review a mockup or sample first?
settings.answer: Get a free custom mockup before you order. Physical samples are available for qualifying projects; our team will confirm arrangements and any delivery cost. Request a sample. For an in-person review, request an office visit in Dallas–Fort Worth. Our representative comes to your office; the location and appointment details require confirmation.

settings.question: How long will my order take?
settings.answer: Small orders can be ready in as little as 1 business day. Turnaround time varies by product, quantity, design complexity, artwork approval, and inventory availability. Your quote will confirm the project schedule; shipping time is separate.

settings.heading: What else would you like to know?
What do you have in mind?
settings.text: Tell us who the gift is for, your estimated quantity and your target date. We will help you define the next step.
